Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Handcrafted Wool-and-Cotton Rug with Undulating Stripes, 5' x 8', Cream and Taupe
Materials: wool
This handcrafted rug is created with space-dyed wool yarn to give its soft, durable pile a subtle but rich color. The undulating stripes of taupe and cream make it easy to blend this rug with any existing color scheme, and the pattern will give your space added texture. 5'W x 8'L Pile: 100% wool; backing: 100% cotton Handcrafted by artisans in India using a looped-and-cut technique and space-dyed yarns to give subtle color Pair with a rug pad (sold separately)
